Seed Rush

A free daily 1-minute Bible verse game about money, work and stewardship.

Play today's Seed Rush Practice Study the verses

Next round in –

How to play

  1. Pick a mode. Easy, Medium or Hard.
  2. Fill in the missing words before the minute runs out. Each verse gets one try.
  3. Come back tomorrow. The day resets at 7:00 AM Eastern, with a new order of verses.

Three modes

  • Easy

    1 blankPick from 3 words

    1 point per verse

  • Medium

    3 blanksPick from 6 words

    2 points per correct word

  • Hard

    3 blanksType the words

    5 points per correct word

All modes share one leaderboard, so Easy is a good place to practice before moving up.
